# WayForWhitecoat

> WayForWhitecoat is an MBBS-abroad consultancy that helps Indian students study medicine at globally recognised (NMC & WHO-approved) universities across 26+ countries, with transparent fees, end-to-end admission guidance, and visa support.

WayForWhitecoat provides free counselling on university selection, eligibility (NEET), course duration, fees, scholarships, and the admission & student-visa process. The site is organised into a home page, an about page, a country directory, per-country guides, a gallery, and a contact page.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.wayforwhitecoat.com/): Overview of MBBS-abroad services and destinations.
- [About Us](https://www.wayforwhitecoat.com/about.html): Who WayForWhitecoat is and how the counselling process works.
- [MBBS Abroad Destinations](https://www.wayforwhitecoat.com/countries.html): Directory of all 26+ countries to study MBBS.
- [Gallery](https://www.wayforwhitecoat.com/gallery.html): Student stories, campus visits and events.
- [Contact](https://www.wayforwhitecoat.com/contact.html): Enquiry form and contact details for free counselling.
